annotations.title: Get the history of a fact

description: Get every value one fact of a business (phone, hours, address, name) has held, with which source said it and when: how settled a value is.

business.description: The truvon_id from a result (biz_…) or the business's website domain. Never a name

field.description: The field, e.g. phone, address, hours, name; leave out for every field in short

format.description: The form of the history: markdown (the default, as text) or json (the same history as structured data)

name: get_field_history

field.description: The field asked for; null for every field in short

fields.description: With format json: each field with every value it has held, its sources and dates

links.description: With format json: the addresses of the business's record and of this history

url.description: With format markdown: the address of this history in Markdown

title: Get the history of a fact
